name: Murderer's Machete, Greater
body:
Source Horror Adventures pg. 215
Aura strong conjuration [evil] CL 13th
Slot none; Price 78,310 gp; Weight 3 lbs.
Description
This item functions like a murderer’s machete, but is a +2 keen wounding short sword.
Construction
Requirements Craft Magic Arms and Armor, bleed, cruel jaunt (see page 114), keen edge,/i>, creator must sacrifice a sentient living creature; Price 39,310 gp
